title: Initial Build Offer · Northside Kings ↔ Ravens Regime

title: Initial Build Offer · Ravens Regime ↔ Mile High Royal Lions

analysis.executiveSummary: Ravens Regime's proposed foundation package offering three Tennessee running backs (Tony Pollard, Tyjae Spears, Nicholas Singleton) plus a late 2027 4th-round pick for Marvin Harrison represents a heavy quantity-for-quality construction. While Tony Pollard (70.6 C-AVI) provides immediate starting RB2 utility for Mile High Royal Lions (who are currently starting J.K. Dobbins at RB2), bundling three RBs from the exact same NFL backfield creates structural redundancy for the trade partner. Furthermore, for Ravens Regime, stripping all secondary RB depth behind Derrick Henry and rookie Kyle Monangai leaves the backfield severely exposed to injury risk. AVI recommends revising the offer to send Pollard, a young ascending WR asset in KC Concepcion, and a 2028 2nd-round pick, preserving Ravens Regime's RB depth while offering Mile High Royal Lions a far cleaner mix of immediate RB starter value, long-term WR potential, and premium draft equity.

submitted.summary: The submitted offer yields elite 24-year-old receiver Marvin Harrison (84.0 D-AVI), but at a steep structural cost to Ravens Regime's roster integrity. By surrendering Pollard, Spears, and Singleton simultaneously, Ravens Regime liquidates its entire RB depth chart behind 32-year-old Derrick Henry and rookie Kyle Monangai. Furthermore, Harrison's current 64.9 C-AVI does not upgrade Ravens Regime's starting wideout/FLEX core (Flowers 93.7, Tate 75.6, Pitts 74.6, Juwan Johnson 74.5), rendering him a bench upside piece in the short term while leaving the user's running back room dangerously fragile.

This package provides Mile High Royal Lions with an immediate RB2 upgrade for their championship push, a high-ceiling 22-year-old WR prospect to replenish receiver depth, and legitimate draft capital. Crucially, it preserves Spears and Singleton on Ravens Regime to maintain backfield protection while acquiring Harrison.
